enemies.name: Crestcaller
enemies.flavour_text: The most commonly seen beast in the outskirts of Houei. Herd animals that feed on bamboo. Though small and weak, they reproduce very quickly, and are depicted in even the oldest annals of Houei.

abilities.text: Temporary gains Frighten when nearby enemy units die.
Gains extended Frighten when <Lord of Thunder> is on the field.

enemies.name: Shellsnap Newt
enemies.flavour_text: Newts that dwell in the depths of the bamboo groves. Naturally timid, they carry around their own eggshells even after hatching, so that they may withdraw into them at any time.

abilities.text: Curls up and stops attacking when your units are nearby, or if <Lord of Thunder> is on the field.

enemies.name: Snatchshell Bug
enemies.flavour_text: Soft-bodied organisms that live in bamboo groves. They possess small bodies, and are fond of finding giant vessels to make into their homes, hiding within them at the first sign of danger.

abilities.text: Starts with Barrier proportional to Max HP.

enemies.name: Guzzlemuff
enemies.flavour_text: Large beasts that dwell upon snowy mountains. They are huge, and their strong forelimbs are able to effortlessly grab smaller beasts—adult humans, even—before swallowing them whole in their enormous mouths. Houei has many tales involving them, mostly used to scare children.

abilities.text: Eats adjacent enemies with Weight 2 or below, increasing the Attack Range of its next attack and dealing AoE damage.

enemies.name: Flipshell Tortoise
enemies.flavour_text: Ordinary tortoises. Discovered near an underground river. Extremely aggressive, they withdraw into their shells upon spotting another animal, only so they can launch themselves at their foes at high speeds. People seeing them for the first time are usually unable to react.

abilities.text: Deals damage to allied units it passes through when unblocked.
Wyvern Riding: Flipshell Tortoise rolls towards target location, disappearing on arrival and dealing True damage and Slow to all ground enemies along the way.

enemies.name: Gloomweaver
enemies.flavour_text: Spiders widely found across the underground bamboo grove. They weave extremely sticky webs between the bamboo stalks. A moment of carelessness will leave you bound, turning you into their next meal.

abilities.text: Fires threads at the allied unit with the highest HP in Attack Range, dealing continuous Stun and Arts damage.
Wyvern Riding: Gloomweaver moves to target location and fires threads at the 3 enemies with the highest HP in Attack Range, dealing continuous Stun and Arts damage, then leaves the field.

enemies.name: Hexhowl
enemies.flavour_text: Wolves that were once exterminated in Houei, reappearing alongside this new calamity. They have all the most vicious traits of ordinary wolves—pack tactics, cruelty, cunning—except heightened by the curse.

abilities.text: Attacks hit three times, dealing Arts damage.
ATK is reduced whenever damage is taken, up to a maximum of 10 times.

enemies.name: Rocksheller
enemies.flavour_text: Beasts that are entirely alien to Houei. Any threat approaching them will be torn to shreds by their incredibly strong forelimbs, while any prey attempting to flee will discover they can raise rock walls to cut off their escape.

abilities.text: Creates 'Weathered Fragments' in the 4 adjacent tiles, causing those tiles to be undeployable.
Wyvern Riding: Rocksheller emerges at target location, creating deployable Entrenched Rocks in the 4 adjacent tiles before leaving the field.

enemies.name: 'Iju' Escorchgot
enemies.flavour_text: The Iju of the current cycle, the lord of the lava realm. Possesses the power of the curse, and wishes to transform the snowy mountains into its lair.

abilities.text: Can attack up to 4 targets at once and ignites targets it attacks, dealing Immolation damage over time
Gains significantly increased ASPD when HP drops to half
Self-immolates when blocked, dealing heavy damage
Curses surrounding tiles, causing enemies on them to gain increased Movement Speed; Wyvern Riding is more effective when targeting cursed tiles.

enemies.name: Lord of Thunder
enemies.flavour_text: The Iju of the previous cycle, named for the thunder and lightning twisting around its form. Allegedly, it gathers countless Thunderbugs while it hunts. It can manipulate the electricity coursing over it to increase the strength of its leaps or enter a supercharged state.

abilities.text: Charging State
[Charge Electricity] Charges in place, accumulating stacks of charge. Becomes supercharged at a certain number of charges.
[Thunderclap Roar] Stuns all other units in a large range.

[Lightning Leap] Charges up and leaps to the area with the most allied units, dealing area damage to allied units. Then charges up and leaps to the area covered by the fewest allied Attack Ranges and performs [Charge Electricity] 2 times.

[Thunderous Rampage] Charges up and locks on to an allied unit within a certain range, charging towards them (stopped by high ground), and dealing damage to allied units it passes through. Then, [Charge Electricity] twice.

[Homing Ball Lightning] Charges up and leaps to the area covered by the fewest allied Attack Ranges, then fires three lightning balls that deal Arts damage. Then performs [Charge Electricity] 2 times.
Supercharged State
[Thunder Armor] Immune to Paralysis, and gains status resistance.
[Scatter Lightning] Returns to Charging State after taking a certain amount of damage, or when it enters a mountable state.
[Greater Thunderclap Roar] Stuns all other units in a large range, and temporarily gains increased ATK.
[Chain Thunderclap] Charges up and leaps to the area with the most allied units, dealing area damage to allied units 3 times.
[Thunderous Gallop] Charges up and locks on to an allied unit within a certain range, charging towards them (stopped by high ground), and dealing damage to allied units it passes through.
[Spread Lightning] Charges up and leaps to the area covered by the fewest allied Attack Ranges, and fires six lightning balls that deal Arts damage.
Wyvern Riding State

[Wyvern Riding: Thunderous Rampage] After placing 'Wyvern Riding: Zinogre', Lord of Thunder charges directly towards the target, taking heavy damage if it hits high ground. If Lord of Thunder hits high ground twice while Wyvern Riding is active, it is temporarily toppled, reducing its DEF and RES, and its tail can be cut after dealing a certain amount of damage.

enemies.name: King Crestcaller
enemies.flavour_text: The leader of the Crestcallers, making a loud sound with its nose to warn its herd of danger. Also the first to run at the sight of danger.

abilities.text: Temporary gains Frighten when nearby enemy units die.
Gains extended Frighten when <Lord of Thunder> is on the field.

enemies.name: Shellsnap Newt Daimyo
enemies.flavour_text: Eldest of the Shellsnap Newts, over time it has hardened its shell in various ways. Not even a Guzzlemuff can break it easily now. The price is that it can no longer shed its shell.

abilities.text: Curls up and stops attacking when your units are nearby, or if <Lord of Thunder> is on the field.

enemies.name: Ringleader Snatchshell Bug
enemies.flavour_text: A strong Snatchshell Bug that seeks a vessel not just to protect itself, but to prove itself. Suponosuke hopes that one day, one will be able to carry a whole house on its back, after hearing about certain Terran traditions from Orchid and Catapult.

abilities.text: Starts with Barrier proportional to Max HP.

enemies.name: Aragami Guzzlemuff
enemies.flavour_text: A gourmet amongst Guzzlemuffs, much more docile than usual. Legends of these creatures have evolved from horror stories to warm tales of guardianship, though in reality, it is simply because it has eaten so much that it has become picky.

abilities.text: Eats adjacent enemies with Weight 2 or below, increasing the Attack Range of its next attack and dealing AoE damage.

enemies.name: Shackled Flipshell Tortoise
enemies.flavour_text: A Flipshell Tortoise corrupted by the curse, making its shell incredibly heavy. The curse has had strange effects on its speed: it may seem slow one moment, only to be right in front of you the next.

abilities.text: Deals damage to allied units it passes through when unblocked.
Wyvern Riding: Shackled Flipshell Tortoise rolls towards target location, disappearing on arrival and dealing True damage and Slow to all ground enemies along the way.

enemies.name: Raging Gloomweaver
enemies.flavour_text: A Gloomweaver corrupted by the curse; a dangerous foe that spews threads that also carry the curse. Those bound by its threads become either its food or slaves to the curse.

abilities.text: Fires threads at the allied unit with the highest HP in Attack Range, dealing continuous Stun and Arts damage.
Wyvern Riding: Raging Gloomweaver moves to target location and fires threads at the 3 enemies with the highest HP in Attack Range, dealing continuous Stun and Arts damage, then leaves the field.

enemies.name: Greater Hexhowl
enemies.flavour_text: In ancient Houei texts, Hexhowls are considered the harbingers of destruction. While they retain the habits of wolves, every sprint and bite is imbued with the curse, threatening to bring great calamity upon Houei.

abilities.text: Attacks hit three times, dealing Arts damage.
ATK is reduced whenever damage is taken, up to a maximum of 12 times.

enemies.name: Cursed Rocksheller
enemies.flavour_text: A Rocksheller corrupted by the curse, which has strengthened its forelimbs and given it the power to easily alter the terrain. It is the only thing that can threaten the Lord of Thunder, and as such has become the Lord of Thunder's target.

abilities.text: Creates 'Weathered Fragments' in the 4 adjacent tiles, causing those tiles to be undeployable.
Wyvern Riding: Cursed Rocksheller emerges at target location, creating deployable Entrenched Rocks in the 4 adjacent tiles before leaving the field.
